map.：天然气 2.8 元/m³、热值 9.6 kWh/m³、锅炉效率 90%：有效热: : Natural gas at 2.8 CNY/m³ with a heating value of 9.6 kWh/m³ and 90% boiler efficiency: effective heat cost is about 2.8/(9.6 x 0.9) = 0.324 CNY per kWh of heat. Electric heating for the same heat costs 0.58 CNY/kWh, so gas is cheaper. Note: with a low electricity price or a heat pump COP above 1.8, electric heating may come out ahead.

map.热泵和燃气怎么选？: How to choose between a heat pump and gas?
map.热泵 COP>燃气效率/气价·电价 时更省；低温区热泵退化需实测对比。: A heat pump saves more when its COP exceeds gas efficiency divided by the gas-price/electricity-price ratio; in cold regions heat pump performance degrades, so compare with measured data.
